Edit image1 into ONE genuinely new full-body SOUTH FRONT WALK frame 16/16. Transparent background, native square >=1024. Image1 locks original character and camera, image2 original identity, image3 approved rounded bright hand-painted Daoist chibi style.
Required phase: RIGHT-OF-PICTURE leg reaches foreground right before its heel contact, boot only tiny clearance above ground. LEFT-OF-PICTURE leg trails behind pushing off with grounded toe. Close to image1 contact, but distinct pre-contact pose and knee bend. Next frame is image1.
This is a SHORT LOW walking step with natural ankle articulation, not a kick. Boots remain below pelvis; minimum exposed outsole, no large sole facing camera. Both complete black-gold boots visible. One toe or sole is supporting weight. Do not reuse or move the reference pose. Draw newly articulated knees/ankles, cloth folds, small hair/tassel motion.
Preserve face, red/gold star crown, dark high bun and long hair, black/red/ivory/gold costume, star belt, all markings and size. Anatomical right hand screen-left holds original complete astrolabe; left hand screen-right holds exactly three star cards. Torso/head front-facing, same calm smile and proportion. Full character within generous margins, body axis x512, supporting sole baseline y942 relative to 1024. No head size change. Clean alpha edges without colored fringe, no floor or shadow, no UI/text, no sheet or multiple poses.
